messages:
Zoe (Design): quick pitch: a slim "scanline" between timepicker + heatmap that merges p95 sparkline + throughput ticks. goal: fast visual triage and 1-click jump. reactions?
Marco (Frontend): neat. worried about cramped controls at 360px. propose a collapsed compact mode that hides bars.
Lin (Eng Runtime): backend ok to provide 30s/60s buckets. we'll add a severity tag and sampling_ratio. default sampled for ranges >1h to save cost.
Sera (Product): must be action-first: jump, pin, toggle sampling. pin should show up in a comparison rail. keep labels concise.
Ava (A11y): a11y: no hover-only reveals. chevron must be tabbable, aria-label="Jump to interval". provide an offscreen summary on focus: "p50 95ms, p95 420ms, throughput 210r/s".
Zoe (Design): UX detail: show chevron on hover/focus; for touch, longpress reveals pin. also colorblind-friendly palette + icon for severity.
Marco (Frontend): implement as offscreen canvas + svg overlays for hit targets to minimize DOM. will lazy-render tooltips.
Ava (A11y): canvas fallback: add role="region" and aria-labelledby to hidden summary. ensure focus ring >=3:1 contrast.
Lin (Eng Runtime): we'll cap pinned intervals per user at 5 and include pinned metadata in /v1/intervals response.
Sera (Product): microcopy: prefer "Spike" over "Anomaly". show severity text (info/warn/critical).
Marco (Frontend): interaction: Enter/Space activates pin; ARIA-pressed for toggle; data-interval-id attrs for analytics.
Zoe (Design): sampling control: small toggle labeled "Preview (sampled)" with an overflow item "Load full range". default sampled for big ranges.
Ava (A11y): tooltip delay 250ms for keyboard discoverability. add keyboard shortcut hint in tooltip.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: design-proto/scanline v1 -> staging at 2024-07-10T11:00Z :rocket:
Zoe (Design): next: Marco to proto canvas approach, Ava to draft a11y spec + narration examples, Lin to add resolution + severity fields, Sera to update PRD microcopy. i'll post figma by EOD. :+1:
